scv_something_nasty.flavour: Best not to ask what was in the jar.

sor_everything_at_once.flavour: You did ask what it could do.

sor_quick_change.flavour: Frog, hen, turnip. Whatever is quickest.

enc_every_string.name: Every String
enc_every_string.flavour: They were glad to be asked.

enc_hall_of_faces.name: Hall of Faces
enc_hall_of_faces.flavour: All of them yours. None of them you.

shd_echoing_host.name: Echoing Host
shd_echoing_host.flavour: They learned the cut by watching.

shd_the_last_waltz.name: The Last Waltz
shd_the_last_waltz.flavour: Nobody else is left standing to see it.

shd_copied_cuts.name: Copied Cuts
shd_copied_cuts.flavour: The shades know the old tricks too.
